# Repository Skill File Convention

Repository-scoped skills follow the existing convention used under `.agents/skills/`.

Each skill directory stores one `SKILL.md` file with only `name` and `description` in its frontmatter.

Each `SKILL.md` must remain at or below 300 lines.

Large bodies of skill instructions may be split by responsibility into multiple skill directories. Each resulting directory must follow the one-`SKILL.md`, 300-line limit.

When the user requests full information preservation, retain all source information across the resulting skill family without summarizing or omitting substantive content.
